# Copilot instructions for Along

This repository follows the product and engineering requirements in AGENTS.md and docs/SPEC.md.

- Frontend: Next.js App Router, TypeScript strict, Tailwind, Motion, Lucide
- Backend: Django + Django REST Framework under /api/v1/
- Database: PostgreSQL with migration-managed btree_gist extension
- Local orchestration: Docker Compose
- Keep user-facing strings centralized and use Bangladesh settings by default
